t1.name: Lucas R.
t1.quote: AJ Fit completely changed my relationship with training and food. In 4 months I gained more energy, definition and, above all, discipline.
t1.highlight: The plan works and the support makes all the difference!

t2.name: Marina S.
t2.quote: I'd tried other apps before and always gave up. With AJ Fit the workouts actually fit my routine and I finally see progress every week.
t2.highlight: For the first time, I managed to stay consistent!

t3.name: Bruno A.
t3.quote: Tracking load and volume helped me break through a plateau. In 3 months I gained strength across every main lift.
